before.meaning: Whether a live or attention signal indicator plays its pulse animation; reduced-motion preferences always stop it.
before.whenToUse: A decorative signal indicator offers an optional pulsing emphasis that the consumer can switch to a static presentation.
before.avoid: Loading or progress animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, or conveying meaning only through motion.

after.meaning: Whether a decorative signal indicator or placeholder plays its pulse animation; reduced-motion preferences always stop it.
after.whenToUse: A decorative signal indicator or content placeholder offers an optional pulsing emphasis that the consumer can switch to a static presentation.
after.avoid: Progress or completion animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, or conveying meaning only through motion.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Decorative pulse toggle of signal indicators and empty content placeholders only. Loading state semantics, progress or completion animation, general motion toggles for interactive components, animation timing or easing control, and conveying meaning only through motion stay excluded; id, name, aliases, exceptions and status are unchanged.
